summary: Seven-phase plan redesigns the email-census freshness gate from strict on-disk-files-vs-deduped-messages equality to a reachable file-vs-file comparison ((a) path-prefix post-filtered notmuch --output=files) plus a bounded tolerance ((b) Delta<=max(5, ceil(10% of on-disk))) and a reindex-ran marker ((c)), defined once in staleness-detection.md then propagated to census.nix/mbsync.nix (cross-repo) and all enumerated in-repo doc/skill sites, verified [ok] live for both Gmail and Logos, with the 22-unindexed-Logos-files anomaly and the --account positional-arg bug handed off as separate follow-up tasks.

artifacts.summary: Phased implementation plan: (1) define new freshness-line semantics (file-vs-file + tolerance + reindex marker + canonical line format) in the authoritative staleness-detection.md; (2) cross-repo census.nix freshness block + mbsync.nix reindex marker (write-only, no rebuild/commit/push); (3) wrapper-contracts.md §13; (4) skill-email-cleanup SKILL.md Stage 1 gate + remediation; (5) lower-stakes docs; (6) live verification reaching [ok] for Gmail and Logos; (7) spawn follow-ups for the 22 unindexed files and the --account bug.
